How the Lord calls Enoch: the People take Counsel to go to kiss him in the Place called Achuzan

1 When Enoch said these words to his sons, and the princes of the people, all the people far and near heard how the Lord ealled Enoch. And they took counsel, and they all said: ‘Let us go and kiss Enoch!’

2 And the men assembled to the number of 2000, and came to the place Achuzan, where Enoch was, and his sons.: And the elders of the people came together and made obeisance and kissed Enoch, and said to him: ‘Enoch, our father?; be thou blessed of the Lord, the eternal King!’
4 And now bless thy sons, and all the people, that we may be glorified before thee to-day.
